findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the underside of the soda machine to be soiled with food residue. Specifically the bottom-facing surface where the nozzles attach. Discussed with PIC, and PIC had the machine cleaned immediately. Ensure the underside of the machine is cleaned regularly enough to keep it clean.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: (Repeat x2) Inspector observed there to be an unused ice machine and prep cooler in the facility. The facility has been asked to remove machinery during the past two inspections. Ensure this machinery is removed from the facility to prevent pest harborage conditions.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.114 Maintaining Premises, Unnecessary Items and Litter. The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: Inspector observed no employee reporting paperwork. PIC was educated on the importance of having this paperwork. A follow up will be conducted 11/25/2024 to ensure that all employees have signed reporting documents.

(A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.12: Inspector observed roller grill to be heavily soiled with food buildup. PIC was educated on cleaning of food cooking surfaces. Ensure that roller grill is cleaned once a day.

(A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Inspector observed 1) soda machine nozzles 2) REPEAT milkshake mixer and 3) slushy nozzles to be heavily soiled by food debris. PIC was educated on the importance of keeping food contact surfaces clean. Ensure these are all clean by the next follow-up date, 11/25/24.

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: REPEAT Inspector observed no date marking on a package of hot dogs in the WIC. PIC was educated on the importance of date marking. A follow up will be conducted 11/25/2024 to ensure items are date marked. Ensure that all open packages of food kept for longer than 24 hours are date marked.

(A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf).

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-904.11: Inspector observed single-service pizza trays being stored right side up and uncovered. PIC was educated on proper storage procedures for single service items. Ensure all pizza trays are stored covered or inverted. 

(A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: REPEAT

Areas observed to contain an accumulation of dust and debris:
-Ceiling vents and tiles surrounding the vents
-All exposed piping and steel surfaces in the facility
-Freezer and cooler fans
The facility does not have a way to dust the high exposed pipes and steel beams in the ceiling.  Ensure employees have the proper tools to maintain a clean facility to prevent dust accumulation.

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT And ice machine and small prep cooler were observed in the back and not in use.  Equipment no longer in use shall be removed from the premises to help prevent pest harborage.  Ensure equipment no longer in use is removed from the facility.

6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Observed several areas in need of cleaning: 1) Mop sink has build up soil around sink 2) Walk-in cooler has a large spill on the floor and debris under milk. 3) Walk-in freezer floors are in need of cleaning as well. PIC was educated on the items needing cleaned. Ensure all of these surfaces remain clean to prevent cross-contamination. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The floors throughout the facility and kitchen area, especially under equipment and shelving, could benefit from an overall general cleaning. The counters throughout the facility are also in need of a cleaning as well. Nonfood contact surfaces should be cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean. 

 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
